sections.title: Season 19 – Haunted Masquerade
sections.description: Unmask Your Power. Haunt the Competition. Season 19 creeps in... ambitious and cloaked in mystery! The Haunted Masquerade event introduces a spooktacular mode where mystical masks grant buffs, twisting every battle into a spectral spectacle. Plus, something wicked this way returns as Junkenstein's Revenge and Wrath of the Bride are back for frightful co-op fights. Then Stadium transforms under the eerie moonlight, unveiling new Heroes, a cursed map, fresh features, and match-defining Gadgets forged in shadow. Across the season, the festive spirit of Halloween stretches wide as Mythic cosmetics rise from the crypt, and a treasure trove of twisted tricks & treats awaits those brave enough to claim them. Welcome to the Haunted Masquerade, ENTER IF YOU DARE!

sections.title: New Arcade Game Mode – Haunted Masquerade
sections.description: It's spooky time! The Haunted Masquerade is Season 19’s costumed centerpiece. Teams wear the mystical masks of currently allied Heroes, each granting buffs that can flip the fight for friends or foes and force fun new compositions. Everyone acquires special abilities based on whose mask they wear, with some granting specific benefits to lore linked Heroes and all of them rewarding synergy at every turn. Enter the Haunted Masquerade… IF YOU DARE!

sections.title: Halloween Terror Returns
sections.description: Your favorite Spooky modes return as Halloween Terror 2025 brings new tricks and returning treats to Overwatch 2. Join forces in this returning fan favorite 4-player co-op mode to defend Adlersbrunn from Dr. Junkenstein and his monstrous creations. Battle hordes of zombie Omnics and powerful bosses in a quest to save the castle from certain doom. Then, continue the story from Junkenstein's Revenge, featuring four heroes—Sojourn, Junker Queen, Kiriko, and Ashe—who must break down barricades, fight off exploding zombie omnics, and defeat powerful enemies like Banshee Moira and Gargoyle Winston to uncover the dark secrets of Adlersbrunn. Navigate through haunted castles, solve puzzles, and face terrifying jump scares as you progress through this atmospheric and gripping co-op adventure.

blocks.title: Hero Mastery Mode
blocks.body: The Hero Mastery mode and courses are no longer available to play.
blocks.dev: Developer comments: As we focus more time and effort into delivering the best experience for Quick Play, Competitive, Stadium, and other new ways to play, we’re going to be shifting focus away from past game modes that haven’t seen as much attention. With this in mind, we’ve made the decision to sunset Hero Mastery courses.

blocks.title: Team Text Chat
blocks.body: New Options added to Social → Text Chat The color of each existing Text Chat Channel (Whisper/Group/Team/Match) can now be set. These default to their existing colors. The color Comms/Pings can now be set. Tabbing through each of the potential text chat channels includes a small new visual element to indicate that the channel has changed.

sections.title: Hero Updates
sections.description: Hero Updates Developer Comments: This patch primarily focuses on balancing hero perks following the Season 18 perk refresh. Based on pick rate, gameplay data, and player feedback, we’re making adjustments to perks to ensure each choice feels meaningful while keeping the options fair and impactful across all heroes.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comment: Power Block can make Doomfist difficult to punish in certain situations. This change reduces its damage reduction slightly, giving opponents more opportunity to overwhelm his block with damage while preserving the flow of Doomfist’s gameplay.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Cage Fight is a powerful ultimate, but its charge rate has been a bit slow. We’ve slightly reduced its cost to help Mauga earn it more consistently, while keeping it balanced relative to its power.

heroes.dev_note: Developer Comments: Reaper’s engage and disengage potential has been too consistent with the addition of Shadow Blink. We’ve reduced Wraith Form’s movement speed to lower his overall mobility, moved Shadow Blink to a major perk, and added Lingering Wraith as a new minor perk to preserve mobility options for players who choose it.

blocks.title: Stadium Competitive Updates
blocks.body: Stadium Competitive will now use the best of 5 format. Powers are granted on rounds 1, 2, 3 and 5 The first team that wins 3 rounds will win the match The mercy rule has been disabled Round 1 completion cash increased to 7500 (Up from 5000) Round 2 completion cash increased to 5000 (Up from 4000) Round complete cash increased to 4250 (Up from 3500) The amount of cash generated each round from healing and damage has been increased MVP bonus increased to 1500 (Up from 1000)
blocks.dev: Developer comments: Now that stadium has been out for three seasons, players have a better understanding of the mode and how it works. Based on this, we think we can move away from the more segmented power curve offered by the 7-round approach, which served us well in these early months. We have been happy with the results of the Quick Play format in Season 18 and we want to bring those same wins to competitive. The goal of this change is to keep the competitive nature of the format while still making it move at a faster pace. We look forward to your feedback on this as we continue to iterate on Stadium and make it the best it can be.

blocks.title: Stadium Combat Text
blocks.body: Display floating combat text numbers for your damage and healing in-world. Works in both first-person and third-person views. Active in all Stadium matches and the Stadium Practice Range. Customize your settings to adjust the size, transparency and the type of data that is displayed. You can also fully disable this feature.
blocks.dev: Developer comments: The progressive nature of Stadium gameplay and growing in power over time makes it a great candidate for displaying damage and healing numbers in the game world directly. We have added a number of customizable options so you can adjust things to find what works for you. We have further improvements and options coming to this feature in future patches!

blocks.title: Armory Filters
blocks.body: Use the new filter tab to find the exact item you are looking for. Filter by item type, stat, rarity, cost and even abilities. Results are shown with complete tooltips and can be sorted to your preference. Buy and sell directly from the filters tab.
blocks.dev: Developer comments: We know it can sometimes be difficult to find exactly what you are looking for in the Armory, with the addition of filters, you can now narrow down your options to exactly what you need.

blocks.title: Armory Sub-Tabs
blocks.body: Items are now broken down into sub-categories. Saved and example builds support sub-tabs as well.
blocks.dev: Developer comments: As the Armory continues to grow, we need to offer better ways to sort all of the data. These new sub-tabs should help you find what you are looking for more quickly.

blocks.title: Stadium Advanced Info Panel Support
blocks.body: Ability Power, Weapon Power and more are all supported. A new Hero Info section has been added that displays health, armor, shields, movement speed and melee damage info. More support for this feature will come in future updates.
blocks.dev: Developer comments: Advanced Info Panel support has been added for Stadium. Use the hero info screen to directly see how stadium powers and items modify your stats.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: Fixed an issue preventing Music Festival Charms from being equippable by all heroes. Fixed an issue that caused an unresponsive state in Custom Game when attempting to escape after a draft concluded. Fixed an issue that caused players that backfilled into a match in which Reaper was being played to experience low frame rates.

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body: Cassidy Fixed an issue with Cassidy’s Silver Bullet occasionally not firing after using an ability. Junker Queen Fixed an issue with Junker Queen that caused her to be affected by flashbangs while using Rampage with the Rampant Charge perk equipped. Wuyang Fixed an issue which caused Wuyang’s Restorative Stream to have a longer range than intended.

blocks.title: Stadium
blocks.body: General Fixed an issue that forced the team to exit a QP Stadium match if a user joined or was invited to the group during the match. Fixed an issue where Ultimate Charge gain from Healing was not being normalized by your Weapon Power and Ability Power. Junker Queen Fixed an issue where Junker Queen’s Bigger Magnet mod did not increase the pull force of Jagged Blade. Mercy Fixed an issue where Mercy’s Supply Surge power did not count as an ability toward Hardlight Accelerator. Pharah Fixed an issue where Pharah’s Launch Vector power did not grant ultimate charge.
